definition: First saved native iterate within69120viewsperside satisfying both repaired_loss / initial_repaired_loss <= relative_repaired_loss and raw d_D / initial_factor_frobenius_norm <= max_relative_d_distance. No interpolated crossing; unreached cases remain censored.
provenance: Thresholds fixed before expanded evaluation. Initial factor norms on two original development slices are2.919423056505318 and2.8323907551932765. Feasibility levels span1% and0.1% of this factor scale; loss levels40% and30% of initial repaired training loss.
